summary: Audit did not complete (BUDGET_EXCEEDED). 3 finding(s) recorded before the failure.

findings.claim: The file is resolved and checked before opening, but the path is opened later by name; an attacker who can replace the file or directory entry in between can race this check and cause the tool to read a different file, potentially outside the workspace.

Grep reads each discovered path by joining it directly to the workspace root instead of resolving and revalidating it through Workspace; a path can be swapped after the walk, allowing the search to read an unintended file or follow an escaping symlink.

The cited file is resolved and validated before it is opened, but the later open by pathname is vulnerable to a time-of-check/time-of-use race; a concurrent replacement can cause evidence to be read from a different file than the one validated.
